sources: Commerce staging runtime and general capabilities
shared_core.clone_rule: reuse code only; do not copy site instance secrets/options/media ownership

per_company_fields.name: elementor_brand_media
per_company_fields.state: empty / placeholder, not safe to reuse former company logo

per_company_fields.name: jetengine_options_pages
per_company_fields.authority: JetEngine site options and individual options page groups
per_company_fields.state: require per-page discovery of post/settings/option keys before generic copy

per_company_fields.name: woo_store_identity
per_company_fields.state: must never clone billing addresses, tax identities or contact values

per_company_fields.name: marketing_contacts
per_company_fields.state: unset until verified; never fill fake email, phone, WhatsApp, social media

per_company_fields.name: media_provenance
per_company_fields.authority: WordPress attachment meta and content references
per_company_fields.state: legacy sources present; preservation of origin and rights required

per_company_fields.name: site_security_and_owner
per_company_fields.authority: MAD4B SCP Site Profile and independent authority registry
per_company_fields.state: site UUID not reusable; no cross-tenant grants

carryover_rules.allowed: template structure, styling, shared commercial logic, safe demo data with verified attribution
carryover_rules.blocked: old-company brand, customer/order databases, real tokens, media with unverified rights, company SEO/contact metadata
carryover_rules.on_conflict: prefer WordPress authoritative Site Profile and per-company option values; block cross-site substitution
carryover_rules.real_domain: wovacation.com must not be silently bound or overwritten by demo domain
